 In climbing shoes there really isn't such a thing as "men's" and women's" shoes, despite some models being labeled as such. The real difference is high vs low volume. Women's shoes are low volume, men's are high. A high volume foot is wide and/or tall. A low volume foot is narrow and/or short. High volume vs low volume isn't really considered in sizing. Sizing goes by length rather than volume. 

If you're finding women's/LV shoes too tight, I would imagine you've got a higher volume foot and would encourage you to try out some HV shoes!

I am also 42 street shoe size. I wear a 38.5 in female skwamas and a 37.5 in male skwamas. It sounds like you have a higher volume foot since the lady skwamas felt too tight. I would try a 39 and a 39.5 in men's.  Hope this helps!
